{{Quote|With us you are ruler of all the Sith, answerable only to the Emperor himself.|[[Darth Marr]] to [[Darth Nox]]|<ref name="The Dark Council">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Dark Council|Korriban}}</ref>}}
The '''Spheres of Influence''' were the twelve domains of [[Politics/Legends|politics]] and power in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Each of the twelve Spheres, also known as Pyramids, was headed by a member of the [[Dark Council]], and between them they encompassed the entire Empire. Through the Spheres, the Dark Council controlled and oversaw the day-to-day operations of the Empire, and every individual and organization within the Empire ultimately answered to at least one of the Councilors through the hierarchy of the Spheres. When the Dark Council was reorganized by the new [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Empress]] [[Darth Acina|Acina]], the seats were consolidated,  with the new councillors managing several spheres at once.

==History and overview==
[[File:Emperor_Kaas_holo.png|thumb|left|250px|The twelve members of the Dark Council each oversaw one of the Spheres.]]
In [[4980 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor Vitiate]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reestablished]] the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], where they would be safe from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Not long afterwards, the Emperor created the [[Dark Council]], a group of twelve [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]] who would handle the day-to-day running of the Empire as the Emperor gradually retreated into seclusion.<ref name="Timeline 11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref> Each Dark Councilor took an aspect of the Empire as their own to rule, ranging from joint control of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]<ref name="Dark Council">{{TORcite|type=codex|Dark Council}}</ref> to the judicial regulation of Imperial society to the ensuring that the [[Sith Order (Sith Empire)|Sith Order]] remained loyal to [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] philosophy.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Every Councilor's successor assumed control of their respective Sphere of Influence, and every organization, group, and individual within the Empire&mdash;whether they were Sith or not&mdash;ultimately answered to one or more Dark Council member.<ref name="Dark Council" /> The Spheres occasionally overlapped, causing conflict between the various Council members, but overall each Council member was responsible for overseeing their own Sphere and dealing with any problems that arose.<ref name="Role">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Role of a Dark Council Member}}</ref> A new Dark Council was formed upon the rise of [[Darth Acina]] to the throne, becoming the first [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Empress]] of the Empire, and the first to rule after Vitiate had betrayed the Sith to fulfill his scheme as [[Valkorion]]. Acina perished during the [[War on Iokath]] and was replaced by the most senior councillor still alive and fulfilling their duties to the Empire, [[Darth Vowrawn]].

==The Spheres==
====Ancient Knowledge====
{{Main|Sphere of Ancient Knowledge}}
[[File:ThanatonMeditationChambers01.jpg|thumb|right|170px|The headquarters of the Sphere's leader]]
The '''Sphere of Ancient Knowledge''' was charged with the protection and expansion of Sith knowledge.<ref name="The Dark Council" /> First led by [[Darth Zavakon]], the Sphere oversaw the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] and ensured that Sith artifacts and archaeological discoveries were handled correctly and benefited the Sith Order.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Darth Arctis]] was replaced by [[Darth Thanaton]] as head of the Sphere near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the Republic,<ref name="Hadra Forces">{{TORcite|type=codex|Hadra Forces}}</ref> and Thanaton himself was succeeded by [[Darth Nox]] after the latter [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Kaggath)|defeated]] the former in a duel.<ref name="The Dark Council" /> It's duties and responsibilities were administered by [[Darth Anathel]], [[Dark Council]]lor of [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine|Sith Doctrine]] after the [[War against Zakuul]].

====Biotic Science====
{{Main|Sphere of Biotic Science}}
The '''Sphere of Biotic Science''' was charged with the command of all aspects of the Empire that dealt with the organic body. The [[Imperial Medical Corps]], [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] augmentation, disease control, [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], and genetic manipulations and experiments all fell within the Sphere's control,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[Darth Acharon]] himself had augmented his own body with cybernetics by the time he led the Sphere near the end of the Cold War.<ref name="Government Clearance">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Government Clearance|Corellia}}</ref> When the [[War against Zakuul]] had concluded, the sphere was managed by [[Darth Malora]] under the new [[Dark Council]], who became the councillor of [[Sphere of Scientific Advancement|Scientific Advancement]]. She was replaced following her betrayal of the Empire due to the involvement of [[Darth Malgus]] in taking control of the Empire's efforts against the [[Jedi Order|Jedi]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]]. Similarly, Malora's replacement [[Darth Savik]] also decided to betray the Empire, due to her respect for the [[Alliance Commander]] in being able to best her in combat, which they had done years before. [[Darth Eldrid]] was a prospective replacement for Savik during that time, as suggested by [[Darth Krovos]].

====Defense of the Empire====
{{Main|Sphere of Defense of the Empire}}
The '''Sphere of Defense of the Empire''' was concerned with the direction of the Imperial Military in order to preserve the Empire and its people from external and internal threats. As a result, the Sphere shared joint control of the [[Ministry of War (Sith Empire)|Ministry of War]] and the Imperial Military with the heads of the Spheres of Military Offense and Military Strategy, and it often coordinated its efforts with the Sphere of Imperial Intelligence.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Darth Marr]], the head of the Sphere during the [[Great Galactic War]],<ref name="Blood of the Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]''</ref> the Cold War,<ref name="Lost Suns 2">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 2|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 2]]</ref> and the [[Galactic War]] with the Republic, felt that it was his duty to protect the Empire against both the Republic and the Empire's own self-destructive policies and infighting like that which plagued the Dark Council.<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> After the [[War against Zakuul]], its functions and assets were under the jurisdiction of [[Darth Krovos]] of [[Sphere of Military Command|Military Command]].

====Expansion and Diplomacy====
{{Main|Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy}}
The '''Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy''' oversaw the expansion of the Empire's borders and directed the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] in its efforts to secure new allies and maintain their allegiances. While the Sphere controlled both diplomacy and expansion, the Sphere's leader determined which of the two the Empire favored during the Councilor's tenure; [[Darth Ravage]], the Sphere's leader by the time of the Cold War, preferred military expansion and conquests over diplomacy in order to further his own interests.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> When the [[war against Zakuul]] had concluded and the new [[Dark Council]] formed, this position was eventually filled by [[Darth Xarion]], who administered it alongside the Sphere of [[Sphere of Imperial Intelligence|Sphere of Sith Intelligence]] while fulfilling his duties as the [[Sphere of Galactic Influence|Galactic Influence]] councillor.

====Imperial Intelligence====
{{Main|Sphere of Imperial Intelligence}}
The '''Sphere of Imperial Intelligence''' oversaw the [[Ministry of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Ministry of Intelligence]], with the [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] reporting directly to the head of the Sphere. All of Intelligence's many divisions, including [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]&mdash;the primary intelligence-gathering arm of the Ministry&mdash;and the propaganda-generating [[Outreach Bureau]] fell under the control of the Sphere's leader, and [[Darth Jadus]] involved himself directly in the workings of [[Operations Division]] of during his time at the head of the Sphere. Following his presumed death with the destruction of his flagship, the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']], Darth Jadus was replaced for a time by his daughter and heir, [[Darth Zhorrid]]. She received much enmity at the hands of the rest of the Dark Council, and the seat was empty at a meeting a few years later.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> It became known as the Sphere of Sith Intelligence after the [[Sith Intelligence]] agency was formed on [[Darth Marr]]'s orders. After the formation of the new [[Dark Council]] by the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Empress]] [[Darth Acina|Acina]], [[Darth Xarion]] eventually became the new councillor in charge of this sphere as part of his jurisdiction as the councillor of [[Sphere of Galactic Influence|Galactic Influence]].

====Laws and Justice====
{{Main|Sphere of Laws and Justice}}
The '''Sphere of Laws and Justice''' directed the law enforcement and justice branches of the Empire, and under the Sphere's control the rigid order and efficiency of Imperial society remained intact and Imperial justice was maintained across the Empire. [[Darth Mortis]], the head of the Sphere<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> by the time of the Cold War, ensured that the Empire remained true to its values and traditions, but understood that relying too much on the traditions of the past could compromise the future.<ref name="The Dark Council" /> [[Darth Shaar]] led this sphere as part of her position on the [[Dark Council]] as the councillor of [[Sphere of Civil Administration|Civil Administration]], until eventually retiring, with [[Darth Norok]] being appointed to the position afterwards.

====Military Offense====
{{Main|Sphere of Military Offense}}
The '''Sphere of Military Offense''' directed the Imperial Military and the Ministry of War in all offensive military operations, commanding the military's firepower and resources in order to destroy the Empire's enemies and ensure their territorial and military supremacy. [[Darth Vengean]]'s elaborate [[Plan Zero|plan]] to restart the Great Galactic War was usurped by his apprentice [[Darth Baras]] before Vengean's death, and Baras' machinations to become the ''de facto'' ruler of the Empire by declaring himself the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]] resulted in Baras' death as well.<ref name="Retribution">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Retribution|Korriban}}</ref> Baras' successor [[Darth Arho]] commanded the military on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]]'s superior, but he was killed by the Republic forces on Ilum.<ref name="The Jedi Temple">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Temple|Ilum}}</ref> His successor, [[Darth Arkous]], took part in [[Order of Revan|Revanites]]' coup and was killed on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]]. [[Darth Krovos]] managed this sphere as the [[Dark Council]]lor of [[Sphere of Military Command|Military Command]] when the [[war against Zakuul]] had passed.

====Military Strategy====
[[File:TORMilitary01.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The Imperial Military fell under the control of three Spheres.]]
{{Main|Sphere of Military Strategy}}
The '''Sphere of Military Strategy''' controlled the battle plans, strategies, and other military procedures in addition to the [[Imperial Conquest Consolidation Corps]], and the Sphere worked directly with the Spheres of Defense and Military Offense to command the Ministry of War. [[Darth Decimus]] and the Sphere orchestrated the [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the renewed war with the Republic, resulting in a near-perfect occupation that was only foiled by the unexpected reactions of many [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] and the formation of a resistance to the Imperial presence.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Darth Krovos]], the [[Dark Council]]lor of [[Sphere of Military Command|Military Command]] was the Sith in charge of this sphere's operations after the [[War against Zakuul]].

====Mysteries====
{{Main|Sphere of Mysteries}}
The '''Sphere of Mysteries''', also known as the '''Keeper of Mysteries sphere''', was the most secretive of the twelve. The rest of the Empire knew almost nothing about the Sphere's inner workings or purpose, and they only understood that the mysteries which the Sphere protected were important to the Empire. [[Darth Rictus]] was the head of the Sphere during the renewed war with the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> It was managed by [[Darth Anathel]], [[Dark Council]]lor of [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine|Sith Doctrine]] after the [[War against Zakuul]].

====Production and Logistics====
{{Main|Sphere of Production and Logistics}}
The '''Sphere of Production and Logistics''' was charged with overseeing the [[Ministry of Logistics]], with the [[Minister of Logistics]] reporting directly to the Dark Councilor in charge of the Sphere. Through the Ministry, the Sphere oversaw the Empire's trade routes, resources, economy, military supply lines, transportation systems, nationalized industries, [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] populations, and other assets and programs essential to the continued functions of the Empire. [[Darth Vowrawn]] headed the Sphere throughout the four decades of conflict with the Republic<ref name="Encyclopedia" />, until eventually becoming the [[Sith Emperor/Legends|Sith Emperor]] after the previous Empress [[Darth Acina]] perished during the [[War on Iokath]].  [[Darth Shaar]] took command of the Sphere following the aftermath, until eventually retiring so that [[Darth Norok]] can take her place.

====Sith Philosophy====
{{Main|Sphere of Sith Philosophy}}
The '''Sphere of Sith Philosophy''' was tasked with the protection of the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Code of the Sith]], ensuring that the acolytes and apprentices of the Sith Order remained loyal to the tenets of their Order, spreading anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] teachings and propaganda, and also ensuring that the Empire remained free of those who believed in the powers or advantages of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. [[Darth Aruk]] made it his personal mission to destroy the Order of Revan and the mysterious [[Light Sith]] during his time at the head of the Sphere.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />  The sphere was managed by [[Darth Anathel]], [[Dark Council]]lor of [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine|Sith Doctrine]] after the [[War against Zakuul]].

====Technology====
{{Main|Sphere of Technology}}
The '''Sphere of Technology''' oversaw the creation of powerful new cybernetics, [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]], military technology and other revolutionary machines for the good of the Empire. The Sith Lord [[Darth Mekhis]] helped design the [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]] in the years before her ascension to the head of the Technology Sphere,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and during her time at its head she developed the powerful [[Sun Razer]] and many new superweapons before her [[Death/Legends|death]] during a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic SIS]] [[Mission to the Vesla system|operation]].<ref name="Lost Suns 5">[[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 5|''The Old Republic — The Lost Suns'' 5]]</ref> She was succeeded by her rival [[Darth Hadra]], but after her death at Corellia, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Darth Karrid]]&mdash;commander of the prototype warship ''[[Ascendant Spear]]''&mdash;took her seat for a short time before Karrid's own death.<ref name="Annihilation" /> Karrid was succeeded by [[Darth Acina]], who was chosen by the [[Hand of the Empire|Emperor's Hand]] to oversee the ''[[Arcanum]]''.<ref name="Acina">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|Darth Acina}}</ref><ref name="Update">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/2.1.1/5302013|text=Game Update 2.1.1 Patch Notes}}</ref> When the new [[Dark Council]] was formed, [[Darth Malora]] was eventually appointed to the position as councillor of [[Sphere of Scientific Advancement|Scientific Advancement]] until the events of the [[Invasion of Ossus]] where she decided to abandon the Empire. [[Darth Savik]] replaced her briefly until the full outbreak of the [[Third Galactic War]], where Savik also abandoned the Empire due to being defeated by the [[Alliance Commander]], who had earned her respect and cooperation. After these events, [[Darth Eldrid]] was mentioned by [[Darth Krovos]] as a potential replacement for Savik.
